response.sql: WITH matched AS (SELECT o.mktnote, f.feerate - f.rebrate AS net_rate FROM fees AS f JOIN orders AS o ON o.recordvault COLLATE BINARY = f.orderslink COLLATE BINARY), overall AS (SELECT AVG(net_rate) AS avg_rate FROM matched), pair_averages AS (SELECT mktnote, AVG(net_rate) AS avg_rate FROM matched GROUP BY mktnote) SELECT AVG(p.avg_rate) AS mean_pair_net_fee_rate, AVG(p.avg_rate - overall.avg_rate) AS mean_excess_overall FROM pair_averages AS p CROSS JOIN overall WHERE p.avg_rate > overall.avg_rate
